source_summary: Snowy/misty Chinese landscape with pale ink washes, central cliff-mountains, a grey water basin, small architecture on ledges, winding paths, bare winter trees, shrubs, and rocky foreground; calligraphy and red seals are excluded.

motifs.name: left_cliff_hut
motifs.description: Small peach-washed hut perched on a pale snowy ledge at the left side, with angular black roof lines and surrounding soft cliff contours.
must_preserve: peach color accent on hut walls
dark ink roof geometry and ridge line
faint grey contour washes around the cliff
small dotted vegetation below the ledge

motifs.name: misty_water_basin
motifs.description: Broad grey mist or water basin occupying the left-center valley, bordered by soft white snowy banks and faint distant shorelines.
must_preserve: subtle tonal transitions in the wash
faint dark stipple marks along distant banks

motifs.name: central_snow_cliffs
motifs.description: Large central mass of snow-covered cliffs and peaks rising from the valley, with pale vertical washes, rounded rock faces, and dark textural dots.
must_preserve: vertical grey wash streaks on cliff faces
dark stippled moss and rock texture
soft mist transitions at the lower cliff bases
thin contour lines defining overlapping peaks

motifs.name: left_mid_layered_bluffs
motifs.description: Horizontal layered bluffs behind the central valley, with flattened terraces, dark dotted edges, and light grey brush texture.
must_preserve: dark broken ink dots along ridge edges

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_village
motifs.description: Cluster of small buildings or walled structures on the upper-right cliff, set among rock terraces and pale snow banks.
must_preserve: warm brown and peach color accents
stepped cliff ledges around the structures
grey rock wash enclosing the village

motifs.name: right_winding_path_shrubs
motifs.description: Steep winding mountain path on the right side with dark brushy rail-like strokes, shrubs, and rock texture along a snowy slope.
must_preserve: dark vertical and diagonal brush strokes suggesting shrubs or rails
dark wash shadows against the cliff wall

motifs.name: lower_left_winter_trees
motifs.description: Group of gnarled leafless winter trees in the lower-left foreground, with dark twisting trunks and fine angular branchwork over snowy ground.
must_preserve: small blue-green and brown shrub dots at the base

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_stream
motifs.description: Lower foreground rocky passage with rounded boulders, dark crevices, pebble clusters, and a narrow grey stream or path cutting between rocks.
must_preserve: soft grey wash in the stream/path channel
dry-brush rock texture and shadowed bases

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
